bio: On the banks of the Rhine, this restaurant is tucked away behind a somewhat unprepossessing exterior directly above the angling club. The cuisine, based on excellent ingredients and with fish as the centrepiece, is a master class in finesse. In the evening, there are two five-course menus to choose from (as well as à la carte options); on weekdays, there is a very reasonably priced Business Lunch deal. They stock only German wines and the selection is outstanding. There is also a children's menu. The delicious food is served by friendly and attentive staff. In summer, make a beeline for the small terrace with a view of the Rhine and its jetties. Conveniently, the restaurant has a few parking spaces of its own....
